issues.display_title: Issue #420: Integrate Countly analytics for production gallery
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Add Countly Web SDK analytics to the public Villume Gallery so production usage can be measured without polluting data from development, staging, QA, tests, or SSR.

Countly configuration:

  • Server: https://data.gothru.org
  • App key: 1a6125d47199df46ad6106c0a6ca21dad6615168

The Countly app key is a public browser identifier, not a server secret.

Requirements

  • Add countly-sdk-web as an application dependency.
  • Enable Countly only for the Angular production build configuration.
  • Keep Countly disabled for development, staging, QA, unit tests, and SSR. Do not gate it with environment.production alone because QA currently also sets that flag to true.
  • Load the SDK lazily in the browser so it is not executed by SSR and does not block Angular bootstrap.
  • Initialize Countly with debug: false.
  • Track sessions and the initial page view once per page load.
  • Do not enable automatic click, link, form, scroll, or error tracking in this first integration.
  • A Countly load or initialization failure must not prevent the gallery from starting.
  • Tracking starts immediately on production page load; no consent UI is part of this issue.

Acceptance criteria

  • A production gallery page sends Countly session/page-view requests to https://data.gothru.org.
  • Local, staging, and QA builds do not initialize Countly or send Countly requests.
  • SSR does not initialize Countly.
  • Unit tests cover disabled, enabled, and SDK-load-failure behavior.
  • Typecheck, lint, and production/QA/staging builds pass.

Implementation notes

Use an explicit environment config such as:

interface CountlyConfig {
  enabled: boolean;
  appKey: string;
  url: string;
}

Only environment.prod.ts should set enabled: true and contain the Countly URL/app key. Other environment replacements should use enabled: false with empty values.

Verification note

The repository currently has unrelated failures in legacy standalone-component specs. Scope verification to the new Countly tests plus lint, typecheck, and environment builds; record the existing full-suite failures separately rather than treating them as Countly regressions.
